steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A policy needs a scope and an owner, and each clause must not conflict with an existing policy or state a duty without a source.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Clause conflicts with an existing policy
findings.fix: Resolve the conflict before the policy is issued

findings.title: Clause states a legal duty with no source
findings.fix: Cite the source of the duty

outcome.notChecked: Whether the policy is lawful in each jurisdiction.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] clause-leave.md:12  Clause conflicts with an existing policy.
       Fix: Resolve the conflict before the policy is issued.
[medium] policy-owner.md:19  Missing scope.
       Fix: Write the scope.
[low] clause-conduct.md:26  Clause states a legal duty with no source.
       Fix: Cite the source of the duty.
Not checked: Whether the policy is lawful in each jurisdiction.
pros: Checks a missing scope, a clause that conflicts with an existing policy, and a clause that states a legal duty with no source.
cons: Not checked: Whether the policy is lawful in each jurisdiction.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-policy-drafting skill on the records for this review.
